name: FRP client
summary: Advice for a continuously running FRP client with an existing configuration.

recommendations.reason: tired policy for an explicitly long-running client: retry even after a clean exit. This is not an upstream FRP restart requirement.

advisories.message: The documented client invocation uses frpc -c with a configuration path. Preserve supplied arguments and their working-directory context.
Do not infer root, capabilities, high descriptor limits, or network-online requirements from the executable name.
An executable-name match is not verification of the binary or its application version.
